**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Surface conflicting accepted need values**

When two current, admitted assessments for the same project/activity disagree on MW, tier, timing, or duration, these equality guards retain only whichever claim matches the mutable `PowerNeed` projection and silently discard the other. The state endpoint consequently reports the selected value as `SUPPORTED` instead of `CONFLICT`, hiding a live contradiction that should remain visible; collect all eligible field claims and pass differing values through conflict projection.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Declare a response model for project change history**

This new endpoint has no return annotation or `response_model`, so FastAPI exports an empty response schema and the regenerated client types a successful response as `unknown` (`project_changes_endpoint_api_projects__project_id__changes_get`). Any web consumer must therefore cast the payload manually and receives no contract for fields such as `prior`, `new`, or the causal evidence IDs; add a concrete list response model as was done for the adjacent state endpoint.
